title: CapabilityVectorCapture
description: DD-124(1)(2): a value this step's actual SUCCEEDED observation produces for later steps of the same case. key is unique in the case and must be consumed at least once. pointer is present only for GENERATED_REF and must equal an EXPECTED generatedRefs entry of the step's contract key; in a RECEIVER case it equals an INPUT entry and reads the admission the isolated Core produced. ACTION_EXECUTION_ID and OPERATION_ID exist only in RECEIVER cases; a step of a RECEIVER case takes them and CONTENT_REFERENCE_* from its own read and the receiver's read_receipt of that admission, so a capturing step's evidence has reads.
